video_title: Karl-Anthony Towns Brings NBA Finals Energy To The Golf Course 😂 Ft. Diana Taurasi

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on his childhood connection to the New Jersey Nets
quotes.excerpt: I think when they left Jersey that's kind of where my disconnect came

text_blocks.speaker: Diana Taurasi
text_blocks.text: Were you like Knicks or Nets growing up?

text_blocks.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
text_blocks.text: The Nets were in Continental Airlines, so they were in Jersey. I think when they left Jersey that's kind of where my disconnect came and it wasn't as smooth. But those were the teams: Jason Kidd, Jefferson, Kerry Kittles, Kenyon Martin, Calipari was the coach.

quotes.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
quotes.summary_phrase: Karl-Anthony Towns on John Calipari's recruiting style at Kentucky
quotes.excerpt: He was never really pressuring me. It was kind of a swag like I'll do whatever I need

text_blocks.speaker: Diana Taurasi
text_blocks.text: Best John Calipari story when he was recruiting you?

text_blocks.speaker: Karl-Anthony Towns
text_blocks.text: The best thing about him, he was never really pressuring me. It was kind of a swag like I'll do whatever I need to do. I feel like I didn't even know I had a scholarship. I saw the team, I saw the potential it had to win a championship and that team was crazy.
